label: Look LUT
hint: With “+ Import look LUT …” in the list you add a look LUT (.cube, 3D LUT for Rec.709 input), for example a cinema look.

messages.importedOne: “{name}” imported and saved locally in the browser.
messages.importedMany: {count} look LUTs imported and saved locally in the browser.
messages.logConversion: “{name}” looks like a log conversion (S-Log, LogC, V-Log …): the webcam image would get too dark and too harsh. Use a look LUT for Rec.709 input.
messages.loadFailed: Saved look LUTs could not be loaded.
messages.saveFailed: “{name}” could not be saved locally and only applies to this session.
messages.removeFailed: The look LUT could not be deleted locally.
messages.storeFailed: The look LUTs of the project could not be saved locally and only apply to this session.

errors.oneDimensional: The file contains a 1D LUT (LUT_1D_SIZE). A look LUT must be a 3D LUT (LUT_3D_SIZE).
errors.noSize: LUT_3D_SIZE is missing before the values, the file is not a 3D LUT.
errors.count: Expected {expected} value lines, the file has {actual}.
errors.domain: DOMAIN_MIN must be smaller than DOMAIN_MAX in every channel.
